_format: Every visible string on the site. Sections: 'shell' (every page), 'components' (component display names), and one section per page id under 'pages'.
Inside a section, keys are flat names; a dot is part of the name, not nesting (the spec has both 'tile.headcount' and 'tile.headcount.asof').
Each section has a sibling '_status' map giving every key in that section a status: 'signed' or 'unsigned'. Only signed strings may ship.

Signed: see each section's _status. Sources: Workforce size spec section 4 (D-030), Hiring and departures spec section 4 (D-040, including the shell rate keys ctl.rate*, ctl.rate.help.* and chart.noRateAtGrain), Who is leaving spec section 5 (D-044), component display names (D-016), series labels (D-015, D-020; docs/metric-spec.md section 4), grain control (D-033), shell copy (D-034, D-035).

Shared keys live in 'shell': flag.provisional, ctl.component and ctl.component.all (signed with the Workforce size spec, D-030) and flag.smallBase and flag.ytd (signed with the Hiring and departures spec, D-040) are used by every data page. The 'series' section holds the signed category and hire-type labels, keyed by cube column.
The draft badge shows on a page while any key that page uses is unsigned.
shell 'ctl.range.presets' is the administration-preset hook, empty until signed: [{ id, label, start: 'YYYY-MM', end: 'YYYY-MM' or null }].
